notes: «حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي (رحمه الله)» : bare أبي is a relation link; «عن أخيه علي بن مهزيار» is one link named علي بن مهزيار (rule 7)

«قَالَ سَأَلَ رَجُلٌ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ (ع) وَ أَنَا عِنْدَهُ» is a first-person scene: Harun was present; the asker is unnamed and stays in the scene; the Imam is named inside the words after the chain
ruling (rule 11): a narrated encounter where the Imam speaks: the report stops at هارون; whether the Imam is a link (imam_in_text) is left to the owners
the blessing «(ع)» is not part of any surface
